pages.text: Moths roost on trunks and leaves, and bite back if angered. Wear gold and they will not bite.$(br2)Their colour follows the forest they were born in.

pages.name: Birch
pages.text: Birch forests, old growth or not.

pages.name: Spruce
pages.text: Taigas, snowy taigas, old growth spruce and pine taigas.

$(item)Breeding$()$(br)Flowers breed moths. Two of the same colour may, one time in a hundred, have a rare child. Two of different colours have a child of either parent's colour.$(br2)Rare moths have their own entry.
